description: Solve an Ising, QUBO or Max-Cut problem (wai.quantum.ising/1) by simulated bifurcation (dsb, bsb, hdsb, hbsb), simulated annealing (sa) or exact enumeration (exact, up to 30 spins). The answer gives the best state (+ or - a spin, spin 0 first), its energy E(s) = -sum J s s - sum h s, a QUBO's assignment and value or a graph's cut, the problem's digest, whether its arithmetic is exact, the trials that reached the best, a trace of energy against steps, and the operations counted. Only exact claims the optimum; every other method's answer is the best its trials found. Sealed with the service's key, with the run's joules as the host measured them or the reason it measured none; verify_quantum_receipt checks the seal and sums the state's energy again from the problem. A request past a bound is refused before anything runs (J200, J201).

inputSchema.description: One problem (ising, qubo, maxcut, gset or sk) and the method's settings.

c1.description: Bifurcation's coupling scale, c0 = c1 / (sigma_J sqrt(N)).

descend.description: Take each trial's state on to a single-flip local minimum (default false).

dt.description: Bifurcation's time step (the published value for its variant by default; a sparse graph wants a smaller one).

gamma.description: The heating rate of hdsb and hbsb.

gset.description: A weighted graph in the G-set text format: a line `n m`, then m lines `i j w`, vertices from 1; solved as maxcut.

ising.description: An Ising problem: E(s) = -sum_{i<j} J_ij s_i s_j - sum_i h_i s_i over s in {-1, +1}^n. A pair given twice adds.

maxcut.description: A weighted Max-Cut graph, solved with J = -w; the cut is reported.

edges.description: [i, j, w] or [i, j] (weight 1), vertices from 0.

method.description: dsb, bsb, hdsb, hbsb: simulated bifurcation (discrete, ballistic, and each heated); sa: simulated annealing; exact: every configuration enumerated, up to 30 spins (default dsb). Only exact claims the optimum.

qubo.description: A QUBO: Q(x) = sum q_ij x_i x_j + offset over x in {0, 1}^n; [i, i, q] is linear. Solved as its Ising form with s = 2x - 1, made exactly.

sample_every.description: Bifurcation: read the spins every this many steps, and at the end (default 100).

sk.description: The all-to-all spin glass with couplings of +1 and -1 drawn from instance.

steps.description: Steps a trial runs (sweeps for sa; default 1000).

trials.description: Independent trials, each seeded on its own (default 16).

name: solve_ising

digests.description: The BLAKE3 digests the store keeps the job's objects under: its request, its program (a wasmQ run's envelope, under the digest its receipt binds), its result and its receipt.

error.description: Why the job failed: a worker stopped past its admitted memory or the job's time says so, and nothing is sealed.

estimate.description: The plan's memory, bytes, and its work: §4.8's operations for a wasmQ run, amplitudes touched for a qudit job, coupling terms and spin updates for an Ising job, spins drawn and fields moved for a draw.

anyOf.description: The run's result (section 6.4): its outcome, the counts of its shots, its calls and the fuel they used, the modules' digests, the digest of every call, the accuracy, the energy, and the receipt.

callouts.description: The calls into the modules that returned.

counts.description: Each outcome and how often it came, keyed by the program's bits with the highest first.

energy.description: The first version: exactly {"unmetered": why}. The second (section 11.5): {"run", "callouts"}, the run's figure (a reading where the host meters it, the unmetered form with why where it does not, never zero) and each callout's (the unmetered form: no meter resolves one call).

fault.description: Where the run stopped and why (section 6.2): its reason, its shot, its phase, the module, the fuel used, and the callout and budget where they apply.

budget.description: The budget that ran out, where one did.

fuel.description: The fuel the stopped call or instance used.

phase.description: Where in the shot it stopped: a call, or an instance's seed, prior or init.

fuel.description: The fuel used, in all and in the instances' seeds, priors and init; the budgets; and each callout's calls, fuel and most in one call.

blake3.description: A BLAKE3 digest, 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits.

receipt.description: The job receipt every job takes (receipt.v2.json).

shots_run.description: The shots that ended: all of them, or those before the fault.

status.description: ok: every shot ran; fault: the run stopped, and fault says where and why.

anyOf.description: A BLAKE3 digest, 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits.

transcript_blake3.description: The digest of every call's inputs, outputs and fuel, in order, for a run that ended ok; null for one that faulted.

anyOf.description: A program run (wai-quantum qudit run): the counts, the amplitudes asked for, the state's digest and norm, the constants' digest, the work and the accuracy.

amplitudes.description: Each amplitude asked for, by its digits: the integers it is at 2^-30.

blake3.description: A BLAKE3 digest, 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits.
